name: Sylveon

abilities.name: Soothing Ribbon
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

flavor:
Sylveon cuts an elegant figure as it dances lightly
around, feelers fluttering, but its piercing moves
aim straight for its opponents’ weak spots.
